question: Where is the nearest café along the corridor from Caldwell Woods, Chicago, IL to Fox Meadow Park, South Elgin, IL?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) AS geom FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Caldwell Woods%' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Chicago%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) AS geom FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Fox Meadow Park%' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%South Elgin%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 ), corridor_line AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(s.geom, e.geom) AS geom FROM start_point s, end_point e ), corridor_buffer AS ( -- Create a 500-meter wide corridor (250m on each side of the line) SELECT ST_Buffer(cl.geom::geography, 250)::geometry AS geom FROM corridor_line cl ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, corridor_buffer cb, start_point sp WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, cb.geom::geography) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, sp.geom::geography) LIMIT 1;
